subject: Shiny set of dashboards on shinyapps.io

messages.author: d66c79831f7be949
messages.subject: Shiny set of dashboards on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi everyone.

We are implementing a set of dashboards for a client and I am trying to understand what the best tool would be for it.
They don't have a massive budget, so a BI tool is not an option.

My options would be Plotly Dash and Shiny, but I would probably prefer Shiny because I used it several times before. I would go with the professional plan and embed it to our client's portal.

My questions deploying the dashboard on shinyapps.io would be:
- can I set rights on what people can see? e.g. tab-level view permissions?
- can I set up an unlimited number of users (consumers, not devs)?
- I can see that one account can be shared with many developers, however, can you set up developers per dashboard?

Many thanks for the help!

Ana

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: Shiny set of dashboards on shinyapps.io
parts:
1) Within a given application, you would need to implement per-user restrictions.
2) An unlimited number of viewers may be added to private applications
3) An account is limited to 25 members. They have full rights to the account, with the exception of managing billing and account members.

You might want to follow up on the new Shiny community site as some aspects of your questions are more generic to Shiny than hosting on shinyapps.io

Hope that helps!
